response.sql: WITH account_volumes AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_volume, transaction_count, 1.0 * total_volume / SUM(total_volume) OVER () AS volume_share FROM account_volumes ORDER BY volume_share DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;
